第23章 都来同情我吧（第1页）
柳大春之所以有如此想法，那是因为这赵村長的媳妇是个大臀。
赵家三闺女全部遗传她妈，也是如此。
这腰又细，这一对比，更明显，就跟欧美动漫里走出来的女人一样。
赵家的四个女人都是极品，真是便宜了赵天虎。
这一点，柳大春也是羡慕死赵天虎，不知道自己有没有那一天。
“行，没问题，姐姐给你看。来追我吧傻子。”赵妤芳脑子能有什么好主意？？
她是故意让柳大春追的，他的速度快了就会翻车，到时候酒坛全砸，嘿嘿，她就开心，报了这一仇，来解气。
“赵妤芳，你这不是欺负人吗？人家三轮车，人力的，还栽着酒，我们这是电瓶车，怎么可能追得上我们，那三轮车不是成精了？”
赵小小说道，这分明就是不可能输的赌，那就是在坑傻大春啊。
“废话，他是傻子，我又不是，他会跟我赌的，我不坑他坑谁？”
“赵小小，你要是可怜人家，就给他当媳妇得了，干脆这样，你跟我反着赌，我赢了，你就给傻春摸一摸，这样傻子怎么赌都不亏，算是你同情他，哈哈。”
赵妤芳天性爱玩，还玩得不亦乐乎。
赵小小看了傻大春一眼，确实很可怜，赵妤芳和村里人一直都欺负他，都没女朋友，这二十岁了，八成连女人的手都没牵过，真是可怜的。
“傻子，你摸过女人吗？？”赵小小突然问道。
柳大春装模作样地摇摇头，也不知道这个赵小小想干嘛！
“这样，你如果没追上妤芳，那你就输了，你输了，我给你摸，算是姐姐我同情你，替妤芳还你。”赵小小还真是好人，但是貌似有点好过头了吧？？
这简直就是大爱无私，博爱崇高品质啊。

“好呀，我连女人的手都没牵过呢，嘻嘻。”
柳大春装傻充愣的摸着头，真是做梦都没有想到，这世上还有女人因为同情她而用自己安慰他的！！
柳大春这是恨不得所有女人都来同情他了。
“傻子，你来追我们吧，哈哈。”赵妤芳得瑟着，一手转动油门，电瓶车就往前快速开了出去。
“傻子，别勉强，酒翻了咋了就不好了。”赵小小故意泄露了一下，也跟上了赵妤芳。
柳大春踩在三轮车的踏板上，当即运气，将魔气运转到腿上，顿时腿部就有了力气，一股强大的力气，这蹬出去时，三轮车也是快速往前冲。
柳大春越踩越厉害，三轮车的速度也越来越快。
后面的三坛酒已经颠簸了起来，稍微有点坑哇，只怕是都会车毁人亡。
“追我呀追我呀。”赵妤芳还特意回头讽刺了一句，继续往前快速开。
赵妤芳电瓶车的速度已经达到了25码，却还在加速。
柳大春一丝冷笑，继续加大了脚踏板的力量，三轮车的速度像飞一样快，紧随着电瓶车，三辆车子，在这条公路上飙了起来。

Chapter 23 Come and sympathize with me (Page 1)
The reason Liu Dachun had such an idea was because Village Chief Zhao's wife had a big butt.
The three daughters of the Zhao family all inherited their genes from their mother, and the same is true.
This waist is thin, and the contrast is even more obvious, just like the women coming out of European and American animations.
The four women in the Zhao family are all top-notch, which really gives Zhao Tianhu a huge advantage.
At this point, Liu Dachun also envied Zhao Tianhu to death. He didn't know if he would ever see that day.
"Okay, no problem, sister, let me show you. Come after me, you idiot." What good ideas can Zhao Yufang have in mind? ?
She deliberately let Liu Dachun chase him. If he went too fast, he would overturn the car, and then the wine jar would be smashed. Hehe, she would be happy. She had taken revenge and relieved her anger.
"Zhao Yufang, aren't you bullying me? This tricycle is powered by human power and is loaded with alcohol. This is a battery-powered vehicle. How can it catch up with us? Isn't that tricycle a spirit?"
Zhao Xiaoxiao said, this is obviously a bet that cannot be lost, and it is a trap for stupid Dachun.
"Nonsense, he is a fool, and I am not. He will bet with me. If I don't cheat him, who will I cheat?"
"Zhao Xiaoxiao, if you feel pity for someone, you can be his wife. How about this? If you bet against me, if I win, you can touch Shachun. In this way, the fool will not lose no matter how much he bets. It means you sympathize with him, haha."
Zhao Yufang loves to play by nature, and she enjoys playing very much.
Zhao Xiaoxiao glanced at Silly Dachun. He was really pitiful. Zhao Yufang and the villagers had always bullied him and he had no girlfriend. At the age of twenty, he had probably never even held a woman's hand. He was really pitiful.
"Fool, have you ever touched a woman?" Zhao Xiaoxiao suddenly asked.
Liu Dachun shook his head pretendingly, not knowing what Zhao Xiaoxiao wanted to do!
"In this way, if you don't catch up with Yufang, then you lose. If you lose, I will touch you. As a sister, I sympathize with you and pay you back for Yufang." Zhao Xiaoxiao is really a good person, but he seems a bit too nice, right? ?
This is simply the noble quality of selfless love and fraternity.
"Okay, I've never even held a woman's hand, hee hee."
Liu Dachun pretended to be dumbfounded and rubbed his head. He never thought in his wildest dreams that there was a woman in the world who would use herself to comfort him out of sympathy for her! !
Liu Dachun wished that all the women would sympathize with him.
"Idiot, come after us, haha." Zhao Yufang hesitated, turned the accelerator with one hand, and the battery car drove forward quickly.
"Idiot, don't force it. If the wine is spilled, it will be bad." Zhao Xiaoxiao deliberately let it slip and followed Zhao Yufang.
Liu Dachun stepped on the pedal of the tricycle, and luckily, the demonic energy flowed to his legs. His legs suddenly gained strength, a powerful force. When he stepped out, the tricycle rushed forward quickly.
Liu Dachun pedaled harder and harder, and the speed of the tricycle became faster and faster.
The three jars of wine in the back were already jolting, and if there was a slight pit, the car would be destroyed and people would be killed.
"Chase me, chase me." Zhao Yufang turned around and said sarcastically before continuing to drive forward quickly.
The speed of Zhao Yufang's battery car has reached 25 yards, but it is still accelerating.
Liu Dachun sneered and continued to increase the strength of the pedals. The tricycle was as fast as flying. Following the battery car, the three cars sped up on the road.
